data.notes: February 2026 in Rio was dominated by Carnival, with the Sambadrome, street megablocos, luxury balls, and a parallel wave of international electronic parties around the waterfront.

events.title: Rio Carnival 2026
events.summary: Rio Carnival 2026 ran from February 13 to 21, turning the city into its annual samba, blocos, balls, and parade epicenter. The official festival period anchored the month’s music-travel calendar.

events.title: Rio Carnival 2026 — Grupo Especial Samba School Parades
events.summary: The elite Grupo Especial samba school parades took place across three nights, February 15–17, at Marquês de Sapucaí. The lineup included major schools such as Mangueira, Beija-Flor, Viradouro, Grande Rio, and Salgueiro.

events.title: Baile do Copa BR
events.summary: The Copacabana Palace Carnival gala took place on February 14 at 22:00 with the theme “Ponto Br.” The long-running luxury ball centered on Brazilian carnival culture, costumes, and live party atmosphere.

events.title: Carnaboma 2026 Grand Opening: Jamie Jones
events.summary: BOMA opened its Carnival run at Museu do Amanhã on February 13 with Jamie Jones, Adam Ten b2b Mita Gami, Miguelle & Tons, and Giu. The night launched the electronic-programming counterpoint to Carnival week.

events.title: BOMA Carnival: Black Coffee
events.summary: BOMA’s February 14 Carnival date at Museu do Amanhã featured Black Coffee with Ahmed Spins, Carlita, Bhaskar, Jackson, Malive, and Unfazed. The lineup made it one of the week’s strongest afro-house and house bookings.

events.title: BOMA Carnival: Mochakk & Dennis Cruz
events.summary: BOMA’s February 16 party at Museu do Amanhã featured Mochakk, Dennis Cruz, Bob Moses club set, OSGEMEOS, and Halfcab. The event was billed as an all-night-into-sunrise Carnival edition.

events.title: BOMA Carnival: ARTBAT + CamelPhat
events.summary: ARTBAT and CamelPhat headlined BOMA’s February 17–18 Carnival night, joined by LP Giobbi, Departamento, and Tato. The booking leaned into melodic, cinematic club music at the waterfront museum.

events.title: CarnaRIO 2026: Vintage Culture
events.summary: BOMA’s Champions Friday event on February 20 featured Vintage Culture, WhoMadeWho hybrid DJ set, OMRI, Eli Iwasa, and Doozie. The date linked Rio’s post-parade Champions weekend with a major Brazilian electronic headliner.

events.title: Dawn Patrol by BOMA — Carnival Edition
events.summary: BOMA’s Dawn Patrol closing edition at Museu do Amanhã featured MAZ, ANTDOT, Riascode, Bakka, and special guest Kölsch. The event was billed for Saturday, February 21, running late-night into sunrise.

events.title: Camarote Nº1 2026
events.summary: Camarote Nº1 operated as a premium Sapucaí Carnival party during the samba school parades; this entry uses the explicitly listed February 15 date. The official page confirms its 2026 schedule across parade nights with open bar, food, and party programming.

events.title: Bloco da Anitta
events.venueName: Rua Primeiro de Março / Circuito Preta Gil
events.summary: Anitta’s bloco paraded through downtown Rio on February 21, with gatherings starting at 7:00 on Rua Primeiro de Março. Riotur described the show as one of the biggest and most anticipated events on the Rio street-Carnival calendar.

events.title: Baile Sinfônico: Monobloco & Orquestra Petrobras Sinfônica
events.summary: Monobloco and Orquestra Petrobras Sinfônica presented Baile Sinfônico at Fundição Progresso on February 20. The concert reworked Monobloco’s carnival repertoire with symphonic arrangements under conductor Felipe Prazeres.
